issues: 背景整页与中景卡几乎同尺寸，只隔一层 2px 模糊，读起来像两份重复的卡片叠在一起，纵深不成立
前景搜索条细得像一根穿帮的线、前景卡与中景卡同大，近景没有“贴着镜头”的体量
各层单层阴影深浅一致，没有随深度变化的落影与空气透视
中景卡的纵向错落是机械的奇偶 40px
changes: 远景整页缩小一档（2100→1820 宽）+ blur 3px + 降饱和 0.85，上面罩一层上浓下淡的同色空气薄雾（0.42–0.62）
前景放大一档（搜索条 960 宽、高清卡 560 宽）+ 景深虚化 6px + elevation 40–48 的深远落影，并按 velocity() 求速度给横向 SpeedBlur，掠过时才拖影
中景卡改两层软影（elevation 14）保持绝对清晰作为主阅读层，纵向错落改为缓和的波形 [10,46,0,38,14,50]
整体加暗角 0.14 + 颗粒 0.035，底色与页面留白同色，横移不露边
issuesEn: The background page and midground cards are nearly the same size, separated only by 2px blur, so it reads as two copies of the same cards stacked; depth doesn't hold
The foreground search bar is so thin it looks like a stray line, and the foreground card is the same size as the midground ones, with no 'right against the lens' mass
Every layer has the same single shadow, with no depth-dependent shadows or atmospheric perspective
Midground vertical offsets are a mechanical odd/even 40px
changesEn: The far page is one size smaller (2100→1820 wide) with 3px blur and 0.85 saturation, under a same-colour atmospheric haze that is denser at the top (0.42–0.62)

The foreground is one size larger (960-wide search bar, 560-wide hi-res card) with 6px defocus and deep elevation-40–48 shadows, plus horizontal SpeedBlur driven by velocity(), so it only smears while passing
Midground cards get two-layer elevation-14 soft shadows and stay perfectly sharp as the reading layer; the vertical stagger is now a gentle wave [10,46,0,38,14,50]
Added vignette 0.14 and grain 0.035; the base colour matches the page margin so the pan never exposes an edge
